description: List ad creatives in a LinkedIn ad account. Returns creative content type (SPONSORED_STATUS_UPDATE/MESSAGE/etc.), intendedStatus, associated campaigns, and content URNs. Filter by campaign_id to see all creatives on a specific campaign, or by status to find paused/archived ads. Use li_get_creative for full content detail on a specific creative.

campaign_id.description: Filter to creatives in a specific campaign (numeric ID or URN).

name: li_list_creatives
